summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for d3-path serializer instantiation (setup stage, object_creation method). It does not semantically match any existing skill: the three existing skills span codec generation (Flink), performance monitoring (browser), and neither addresses d3 path initialization. Peer candidates (Path Command Execution, Link Rendering Context, custom delimiter parser) are related but operate at different stages (path_construction, rendering, data_parsing) and do not subsume this instantiation step. The candidate has valid support evidence from d3-path API documentation and introduces no conflicts.
